key_insight: Regularized regression can reliably identify ship manoeuvring hydrodynamic coefficients from CFD-generated free-running data, with Ridge offering the best balance of accuracy and efficiency.
engineering_relevance: The study shows how synthetic CFD manoeuvres can support practical ship system identification when coefficient selection and multicollinearity are handled carefully.
method: Train Abkowitz-type manoeuvring models with ordinary least squares and regularized regression.
Use URANS-based zig-zag and turning-circle simulations as synthetic training and validation data.
Compare coefficient-set size, training-length requirements, and manoeuvre combinations.
evidence_signal: The models were evaluated against experimental benchmark data, and performance improved with more diverse manoeuvring inputs and regularization.
watch_item: Large coefficient sets increase flexibility but also multicollinearity risk, so careful feature selection or regularization is essential.
paper_title: Regularized Machine Learning for System Identification of Ship Free-Running Manoeuvres from CFD-Based Synthetic Data: A Comparative Study
